name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, publishes static site content, and applies HTTP, TLS, header, compression, and request-hardening settings.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis, including service management, Redis authentication and logging, and removal of selected replication directives after configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
